knowledge.name: Fixed synthetic supplier portfolio
knowledge.detail: Five fictional suppliers provide spend, tier, region, quality, delivery, financial, geopolitical, and overall-risk evidence.

knowledge.name: Incident and backup-option records
knowledge.detail: Four recorded incidents and five synthetic backup options provide severity, exposure, lead-time, qualification, and premium evidence.

knowledge.name: Review rules and locked case anchors
knowledge.detail: Bundled rules define score weighting, risk tiers, dimension status, exact outputs, and four persona-language acceptance cases.

intelligence_processing.name: Supplier exposure ranking
intelligence_processing.detail: Ranks the fixed portfolio by overall risk and calculates total spend, elevated-risk spend, composite health, and incident counts.

intelligence_processing.name: Risk-dimension explanation
intelligence_processing.detail: Explains each supplier's quality, delivery, financial, geopolitical, spend, tier, health, and recorded incident evidence.

intelligence_processing.name: Continuity disruption assessment
intelligence_processing.detail: Orders recorded incidents by severity and summarizes exposed spend, category, and whether synthetic backup options exist.

intelligence_processing.name: Alternative sourcing comparison
intelligence_processing.detail: Compares backup names, lead times, synthetic qualification states, premiums, and modeled cost for procurement review only.

intelligence_processing.name: Fail-closed evidence handling
intelligence_processing.detail: Uses only the fixed records, labels derived analysis, and reports absent evidence instead of browsing, inventing, or substituting facts.

clients_user_interface.name: Portable RAPP Brainstem chat
clients_user_interface.detail: The single-file BasicAgent exposes four deterministic review operations through local chat, streaming, health, and tool routing.

clients_user_interface.name: Copilot Studio Draft experience
clients_user_interface.detail: Four skills and two synthetic knowledge files support governed previews while validated manual and pilot agents remain unpublished.

clients_user_interface.name: Persona-led procurement review
clients_user_interface.detail: Procurement managers and supply chain directors receive evidence-first results, review options, approval gates, and no-action disclosures.

management_reporting.name: Supplier Risk Dashboard
management_reporting.detail: Reports portfolio spend, elevated-risk concentration, ranked supplier risk, composite health, and active incident counts.

management_reporting.name: Supplier Evidence Scorecard
management_reporting.detail: Reports supplier identity, spend, tier, risk, health, dimension scores, statuses, and linked incidents for review.

management_reporting.name: Active Disruption Alerts
management_reporting.detail: Reports severity, date, supplier, incident description, exposed spend, category, and backup availability for validation.

management_reporting.name: Alternative Sourcing Review
management_reporting.detail: Reports synthetic backup options, lead times, statuses, premiums, and modeled diversification cost without changing sourcing.

tools.name: SupplierRiskMonitoringAgent RAPP tool
tools.detail: Portable Python BasicAgent implements dashboard, scorecard, disruption-alert, and alternative-sourcing review operations.

tools.name: Brainstem runtime
tools.detail: Local-first RAPP server discovers the single-file agent and exposes conversational chat, streaming, health, and routing endpoints.

tools.name: Microsoft Copilot Studio
tools.detail: Hosts the governed Draft experience with four skills and two knowledge files; publishing requires explicit confirmation.

tools.name: Dynamics 365 Supply Chain Management
tools.detail: Approved production seam for supplier, order, quality, inventory, and commercial context; the pilot has no live connection.

tools.name: Approved external risk feeds
tools.detail: Future least-privilege seams for financial, quality, logistics, and geopolitical evidence; packaged data remains synthetic.

tools.name: Power BI
tools.detail: Curated reporting surface for production portfolio exposure; the deterministic package does not publish a live dashboard.

tools.name: Microsoft Teams
tools.detail: Authorized collaboration seam for procurement review and escalation; the package sends no messages or supplier outreach.

supporting_features.name: Fixed synthetic-only grounding
supporting_features.detail: Every supplier, identifier, date, score, incident, duration, status, premium, and cost is fictional pilot evidence.

supporting_features.name: Four deterministic review operations
supporting_features.detail: Persona language routes independently to risk dashboard, supplier scorecard, disruption alerts, or alternative sourcing.

supporting_features.name: Explainable scoring rules
supporting_features.detail: Documents weighted composite health, risk-tier thresholds, and dimension-status bands for reproducible interpretation.

supporting_features.name: Procurement authorization gate
supporting_features.detail: Authorized procurement owners retain qualification, selection, allocation, contracting, ordering, and sourcing approval.

supporting_features.name: No supplier contact or substitution
supporting_features.detail: Backup options are review evidence only; the agent cannot contact, qualify, select, substitute, allocate, contract with, or order.

supporting_features.name: No invention or live-data implication
supporting_features.detail: The agent does not browse or imply live access and states when requested evidence is absent from the fixed snapshot.

supporting_features.name: Locked case and Draft validation
supporting_features.detail: Four persona cases passed strict isolation and Copilot Studio previews while both validated agents remained unpublished Drafts.
